sections.title: Shrub and habitat
sections.text: Ruizia parviflora is a very rare mallow-family shrub endemic to Mount Corps de Garde, Mauritius. It can reach about 4 m tall. Its small, entire, oblong leaves are about 2.5–3.8 cm long.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Pale pink flowers are borne in groups of three on upright stalks. The broad petals do not exceed the sepals. The plate shows the branched shrub, scaly leaf undersides and capsules, consistent with the descriptions available.

sections.title: Conservation and uses
sections.text: The plant was rediscovered in 2001 after a long period with no known observations. The references consulted do not document food use or a specific toxicity; no part is presented here as edible.
